meta_description: Eden Gardening transforms Liverpool gardens with expert landscaping, planting, and design. Local family business. Free quotes available.
hero_subhead: From overgrown borders to stunning outdoor spaces. Eden Gardening brings your garden vision to life with expert design and hands-on care.
services_heading: Complete Garden Landscaping Services Across Liverpool
services_subhead: From design consultation to maintenance plans — we handle every aspect of creating and caring for beautiful outdoor spaces.

services.title: Garden Design & Planning
services.desc: We listen to your vision and create a detailed design that transforms your space. Whether contemporary, cottage style, or low-maintenance, we'll plan it right.

services.title: Patio & Decking Installation
services.desc: Expertly laid patios and timber decking that weather the Liverpool climate. We use quality materials and precise finishing for spaces that last.

services.title: Planting & Borders
services.desc: Professional planting schemes tailored to soil, sunlight, and your maintenance preferences. Colourful year-round gardens that thrive.

services.title: Hedge & Tree Work
services.desc: Safe pruning, trimming, and removal of trees and hedges. We keep your garden proportioned and healthy, with sensitive waste disposal.

services.title: Garden Maintenance Plans
services.desc: Regular fortnightly or monthly visits keep your garden looking its best without the stress. We handle weeding, deadheading, and seasonal care.

services.title: Fencing & Boundary Work
services.desc: New fencing, gate repairs, and boundary restoration that adds privacy and curb appeal. Built to last in Liverpool's weather.

about_pullquote: We started Eden because great gardens shouldn't be a luxury.
about_para_1: Eden Gardening was founded 15 years ago by lifelong Liverpool residents who believed every home deserves an outdoor space to be proud of. What began as a small operation has grown into a respected local team, transforming hundreds of gardens across Merseyside. We've earned our reputation by showing up on time, listening carefully to what customers really want, and delivering gardens that work.
about_para_2: Customers keep coming back because we care about the long game. A garden is never truly finished — it grows, changes, and needs attention. That's why we offer tailored maintenance plans and stay in touch with past clients. We're not here to upsell you; we're here to build something beautiful that you'll enjoy for years.
reviews_heading: What Liverpool Garden Owners Say About Eden

reviews.text: We had a tired old garden that we didn't know where to start with. Mark came round, listened to what we wanted, and drew up a plan. Six weeks later it's unrecognisable — neighbours keep asking who did it. Fair prices too, no hidden costs. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had Eden do our borders and they've just started the monthly maintenance. The difference is night and day. They know exactly what needs doing and they get on with it. No faffing about, just proper work. Will be keeping them on.
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Terrible back garden — just concrete and weeds. Eden designed a little patio area, put in a raised bed, and some nice planting. They even sorted the fencing which was falling down. Real craftspeople. Couldn't be happier.
reviews.author: Michael J.
